---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement grounded in an MSP reporting or operator workflow
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Before filing

- [ ] I searched existing issues and discussions.
- [ ] This is not a vulnerability report; sensitive findings belong in the private process in [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md).
- [ ] I have not included client reports, recipient information, secrets, signed evidence links, or other confidential data.

## The workflow problem

Who encounters the problem: an MSP report author, an MSP operator, a client report recipient, or a maintainer?

Describe the specific moment, not only the desired feature.

## Current behavior or workaround

How is the workflow handled today? What is costly, confusing, slow, risky, or impossible?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest useful outcome. Explain what a person should be able to accomplish once this exists.

## Trust-boundary considerations

Check every item that could be affected:

- [ ] Evidence scope or data minimization
- [ ] Recipient identity, access, expiry, or revocation
- [ ] Tenant isolation or role authorization
- [ ] Authentication, rate limiting, CAPTCHA, or session handling
- [ ] Private worker capability or artifact boundary
- [ ] Self-hosted deployment, environment configuration, or migrations
- [ ] Healthcare Mode B or regulated-data posture
- [ ] Public website, SEO, documentation, or product claims
- [ ] None of the above, as far as I can tell

Explain any checked item. If you are unsure, say so rather than assuming the boundary is unaffected.

## Success signal

How would we know the change helps? A qualitative workflow signal is welcome; do not invent customer metrics or traction figures.

## Alternatives considered

What existing workflow, configuration, or documentation path did you consider?

## Additional context

Add mockups, links, or synthetic examples only. Do not include real client material or secrets.
